Patch Node tooling for October 2026 security releases (#200)

* Patch Node tooling for October 2026 security releases

Pin CI to Node 22.23.4 and 24.22.1, add development runtime guards, and cover encoding-only tooling without changing SDK consumer requirements.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Remove documentation changes from Node security patch

Restore contributing and sample README content to the PR base, keeping the runtime and tooling changes intact.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Keep CI job names stable across Node patch updates

Map build (22.x) and build (24.x) to the patched runtimes in both workflows without changing their execution steps.
